rules.title: Command execution routes
rules.description: Executable routes with optional argv[1..] matching, owned by this plugin instance and projected into AcTrail command enforcement.

rule_id.title: Rule ID
rule_id.description: Stable route identity. New rules receive command-dynamic-N when omitted.

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: Allow or deny this executable, or ask a synchronous control plugin.

executable.title: Executable
executable.description: Exact absolute tracee-namespace executable path covered by a command-policy grant.

args.title: Arguments
args.description: Optional exact argv[1..] matcher. A final * matches any remaining arguments; omit args to match every invocation of the executable.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Higher values win among executable and argv candidates that match the request.

gray_target.title: Gray target instance ID
gray_target.description: Required only for gray. The active control-decider instance that receives the synchronous decision request.
